responsibility: Defines the core Rust frontend AST infrastructure shared by all specialized AST headers: base node classes, token-tree and macro-match abstractions, common enums like node kind and delimiters, cloning/visitor entry points, attribute and crate-level structures, and the `SingleASTNode` tagged union used to store heterogeneous AST nodes. It is the foundational AST model layer that other files extend with specific expression, item, type, pattern, path, and statement node classes.
same_name_distinction: Declares the foundational AST model that rust-ast.cc implements and that other AST headers build on: base node classes, token-tree and macro-match abstractions, common enums, `SingleASTNode`, and crate-level/core support types. Unlike the `.cc` file, it is the primary type-definition layer for the Rust AST rather than the shared method implementations.
